FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_CalculateOutput
VAR_INPUT
    i: INT;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    o: INT;
END_VAR

VAR
    // Temporary variable for state management (if needed)
END_VAR

// Main logic to determine output based on input value
CASE i OF
    0:
        o := 0; // When input is 0, output is 0
    1, 2, 3, 4, 5:
        o := i * i; // When input is between 1 and 5, output is the square of i
    6, 7, 8, 9, 10:
        o := i + 2 * i; // When input is between 6 and 10, output is i plus two times i
    ELSE
        o := -1; // For any other value of i, output is -1
END_CASE;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
